categories.name: rpc
categories.rationale: Fixes a regression on macOS where bitcoin-cli -rpcclienttimeout=0 fails immediately with 'Could not connect to the server'. The PR description notes this is a supported-platform failure introduced in #34342 and present in v32.0 release candidates.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Labeled Utils/log/libs and modifies the shared socket utility in src/util/sock.cpp and src/util/sock.h.
categories.rationale: Prevents select() from returning EINVAL on macOS and BSD systems when large timeouts exceed 10^8 seconds. Caps the timeout in Sock::WaitMany and introduces a dedicated Sock::NO_TIMEOUT sentinel for infinite waits.
